title: Shadow economy as a null set. Measure-theoretic approach to shadow economy
abstract: arXiv:2611.29797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper we asked if the shadow economy can be defined as a system of null sets for institutional measures or sensors that measure economic transactions. As an answer a measure-theoretic testable framework to redefine and quantify the shadow economy was designed. Traditional economic definitions frequently conflate the actual shadow economy with the observational limitations of state institutions. To resolve this, we model the shadow economy as a null set relative to institutional measures and analyze three complementary economic regimes. We explore in this context how standard mathematical tools can be given economic meaning. First, in the low-resolution regime, we apply Banach Lattices and Lebesgue decomposition of a measure to address transaction underreporting by aggregating incomplete institutional registries using a supremum fusion operator. Second, for hidden economic dimensions, we utilize Copula theory and Kullback-Leibler

translated_title: 作为零测度集的影子经济：影子经济的测度论方法
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出了这样一个问题：影子经济是否可以被定义为衡量经济交易的制度性度量或“传感器”的零测度集系统。作为回答，我们设计了一个基于测度论的可检验框架，用以重新定义和量化影子经济。传统的经济学定义经常将实际的影子经济与国家机构的观测局限性混为一谈。为解决这一问题，我们将影子经济建模为相对于制度性度量的零测度集，并分析了三种互补的经济机制。在此背景下，我们探讨了如何赋予标准数学工具以经济学含义。首先，在低分辨率机制中，我们应用Banach格和测度的Lebesgue分解，通过使用上确界融合算子聚合不完整的制度性登记数据，来解决交易漏报问题。其次，针对隐藏的经济维度，我们利用Copula理论和Kullback-Leibler……
tldr: 本文提出一个基于测度论的可检验框架，将影子经济建模为相对于制度性经济交易度量的零测度集，从而把真实的影子经济与国家机构的观测局限性区分开来，并用Banach格、Lebesgue分解和Copula等数学工具对三种经济机制进行量化分析。
